about.lead: A local graphical console for a Proxmox-powered home workstation: sign in with Proxmox accounts, see the host at a glance, open your web services and start systems on the GPU your monitor is plugged into.
about.author: Author
about.auto_sub: new versions are installed every night around 04:30, or right after the host is switched on if it was off; if the menu does not come back, the previous one returns
about.auto_on: New versions will be installed by themselves
about.auto_off: New versions only with the button

fb.title: Write to the author

fb.subject_ph: e.g. the clock freezes after the screensaver
fb.text_ph: What happened and what you expected, or your idea. You can also write it on the phone.

set.designs.lead: Your own designs live in {folder} on the host: updates leave them alone, and one with the same name as a built-in design replaces it.
set.designs.install_hint: one or more .css / .js files, or a .zip with several

set.mywidgets.title: My widgets
set.mywidgets.lead: Widgets of your own live in {folder} on the host, next to the built-in ones; updates leave them alone. Add them to a panel above like any other.
set.mywidgets.install_hint: <id>.js with its look <id>.css and strings <id>.en.json, <id>.uk.json …, or a .zip
set.mywidgets.warn: A widget is code: it runs in the menu with the rights of whoever is signed in. Install only widgets you wrote or trust.
set.mywidgets.admin_only: Installing widgets is for admins (Sys.Modify): a widget is code that runs in the menu.
set.mywidgets.none: No widgets of your own yet.
set.mywidgets.broken: doesn't load: see the error journal in About
set.mywidgets.confirm_text: It disappears from every panel it is on. Its look stays among your designs.

set.look.hover: Hover a monitor: clear → storm → night → dashboard windows

cfg.restart_all: Some changes take effect after the backend and the screens on the host restart.
